tokens.name: velvet
tokens.usage: Page background. Evening is the default for every screen; Daylight is the reveal, the lights coming up.

tokens.name: plush
tokens.usage: Cards: lineup card, blind card, the other person's chat bubbles.

tokens.name: plush-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus and initial discs: anything that sits above a card.

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only (1.53:1 on plush). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: seam-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, chips. 4.48:1 on velvet and 3.97:1 on plush (Evening); 3.55:1 and 3.95:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: pearl
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 15.29:1 on velvet, 13.52:1 on plush, 11.58:1 on plush-raised (Evening); 15.17:1 on velvet and 16.91:1 on plush (Daylight).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, timestamps, helper text. 9.21:1 on velvet, 8.14:1 on plush, 6.97:1 on plush-raised (Evening); 6.79:1 and 7.57:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: lamplight
tokens.usage: The primary action fill (one per screen), progress, selected chips and the speaking ring. Text on it is always lamplight-ink.

tokens.name: lamplight-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lamplight: 9.59:1 (Evening), 8.25:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: lamplight-text
tokens.usage: Accent text and quiet links on velvet or plush: 9.59:1 and 8.48:1 (Evening); 5.42:1 and 6.04:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px with a 2px offset. At least 5.42:1 against velvet and plush in both themes.

tokens.name: on-air
tokens.usage: The live signal only: the on-air lamp and its label. 6.46:1 on velvet, 5.71:1 on plush, 4.89:1 on plush-raised (Evening); 4.72:1 and 5.26:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: nova
tokens.usage: Nova's voice: host lines, the AI label and the callback note in a chat. Always beside the word Nova. 9.92:1 and 8.77:1 (Evening); 6.19:1 and 6.90:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, Report, Block and destructive actions, always with an icon and words. 8.80:1 and 7.78:1 (Evening); 5.87:1 and 6.54:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations such as a confirmed seat. 10.71:1 and 9.47:1 (Evening); 4.77:1 and 5.32:1 (Daylight).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs. Dims the screen without hiding it; never carries text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Countdown numerals and the reveal headline. At most one per screen.

styles.name: display-name
styles.usage: A dater's first name and age, wherever it appears. The only italic display style.

styles.name: caption-live
styles.usage: Live captions in the room, read at arm's length or on mute.
styles.sample: So I told the barber to surprise me.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text and chat messages.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting copy in cards and sheets.
styles.sample: We'll ask you to confirm on the day.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Meta such as listener counts and timestamps. The smallest text in the app.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Between related items: chips, an avatar pair.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Inside compact cards and between list rows.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: screen-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right screen margins.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Around full-screen moments such as backstage and the reveal.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Top of a full-screen moment, below the status bar.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Thumbnails and tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs and compact cards.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the seat ticket.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and the on-air lamp.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable area on any control.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: avatar-m
tokens.usage: Initial discs on lineup cards and blind cards.
